notes: Uses upstream cross-configuration answers, with WORDS_BIGENDIAN=FAIL for little-endian AArch64. Configure answers are build assumptions, not executed Android tests.
Relinks the upstream shared talloc object with SONAME libtalloc.so; PRoot links against that exact filename.
libandroid-shmem uses PROOT_TMP_DIR, supplied by the validated app-private /tmp bind.
Produces review-only binaries outside app/src and never writes approval manifests.
